home.about: Ziqhelanise neyunivesithi phambi kokuba ibe yinyani. Yila umfundi wakho, uphile kumaxesha akhupha abafundi baseMzantsi Afrika (imali efika emva kwexesha, izicelo zosapho, iiveki zovavanyo, isithukuthezi), kwaye ubone inkxaso ekhoyo phambi kokuba uyidinge.
home.about2: Emva kwesahluko ngasinye, uQikelelo lweSemester lufunda izigqibo zakho, luqikelele iiveki zakho ezinomngcipheko kakhulu kwaye lwakhe isicwangciso sokusinda onokusigcina.
why.title: Ukungena asiyonxalenye enzima. Ukuhlala kuyiyo.
why.stat1: Malunga nabafundi bonyaka wokuqala abangama-620 000 abaxhaswa yi-NSFAS ngo-2023. Malunga nama-130 000 kuphela ababesaxhaswa kunyaka olandelayo.
why.stat2: Olunye uqikelelo lucebisa ukuba ukuya kuma-60% abafundi bonyaka wokuqala bayahamba emva kwekota yabo yokuqala.
why.i1: Imali efika emva kwexesha, nerenti ekufuneka ihlawulwe phambi kokuba imali ifike
why.i3: Akukho laptop, akukho data, okanye uhambo olude
why.i5: Iimvavanyo nezabelo ezifika zonke kwiveki enye
why.i7: Ukusebenza, okanye ukukhathalela umntu, ngelixa ufunda
why.i8: Imodyuli oyisilele, okanye iimali ezindala ezithintela ubhaliso
why.everyone: Oku kungokwawo wonke umntu: i-NSFAS, ibhasari, oxhaswa lusapho okanye ozihlawulelayo; ophuma esikolweni okanye obuya esele emdala; ohlala kwindawo yokuhlala yabafundi, oqeshayo okanye ohambayo; unyaka wokuqala okanye osele ekunyakeni wesibini. Ezi ngxaki ziyaqikelelwa, kwaye noncedo luyaqikelelwa.
how.title: Ziqhelanise, emva koko ugcine isicwangciso
how.s1: Imeko yakho yokwenyani: iyunivesithi, ikhosi, indawo yokuhlala, inkxaso-mali, imali, ikhaya noxanduva. Umdlalo wakhiwa ngayo.
how.s4: Emva kwesahluko ngasinye, uQikelelo lweSemester luqikelela iiveki zakho ezinomngcipheko kakhulu kwaye lwakhe isicwangciso sokusinda onokusigcina okanye usabelane ngaso kuWhatsApp.
home.card.setupNew: Yila umfundi wakho: iyunivesithi, ikhosi, ikhaya, imali nokunye. Kuthatha malunga nomzuzu.
home.card.firstDesc: Ukufika, iKota yokuQala, iiMviwo zokuQala nokuBuyela kwiMeko: unyaka abafundi abaninzi abawufumana unzima kakhulu.
home.card.middleDesc: Unyaka wesibini nowesithathu: iimali ezindala, ukufudukela ngaphandle kwekhampasi, ukukhetha isifundo esiphambili, imisebenzi esecaleni nokudinwa.
home.card.finalDesc: Iiprojekthi zonyaka wokugqibela, izicelo zemisebenzi, amatyala amadala nosuku lokuthweswa isidanga.
lang.betaNote: Iilwimi ze-beta: iimenyu ziguquliwe; amakhadi amabali asaboniswa ngesiNgesi.
